The Worm Holes#000.src: Soon Gavel will open a museum for my art...

The Worm Holes#001.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light I - The Worm Holes

similar.text: New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light

The Worm Holes#002.src: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.

similar.text: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. {u}. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.

The Worm Holes#003.src: So this is the site... siochain do d'anamacha i mait...

The Worm Holes#004.src: Even if I am alone on that front...though I understand you are taught differently where you come from. I do not envy you, though I still thank you for your aid thus far.
The Worm Holes#004.dst: 그런 생각을 하는 게 나 혼자뿐이라 해도... 네 고향에선 다르게 배운다는 것도 알아. 네가 부럽진 않지만, 지금까지 도와준 건 고마워.

The Worm Holes#008.src: It looked like it escaped! Did you see where it went?

The Worm Holes#012.src: New Questline Started: The Realm of Light
The Worm Holes#012.dst: 새 퀘스트 라인 시작: 빛의 영역

The Worm Holes#013.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Worm Holes#014.src: Arrighty fellers, let's get this wrapped up now! 'ere's plenty more holes where this one came from!
The Worm Holes#014.dst: 좋아 다들, 이제 여기 마무리하자고! 이런 구멍은 아직 한참 남았어!
The Worm Holes#014.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#016.src: The scaffolds are crackin'! Everyone, get offa there, now!!
The Worm Holes#016.dst: 비계가 갈라진다! 다들 당장 거기서 내려와!!
The Worm Holes#016.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#018.src: Aw, hell... I knew this project was a bust from the start...there goes Willam and Clint cause a' this!
The Worm Holes#018.dst: 아, 젠장... 처음부터 이 공사는 글렀다고 생각했어... 이것 때문에 Willam이랑 Clint가 갔구먼!
The Worm Holes#018.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#019.src: I gotta get someone tough enough to get down there...hm? Hey, a human! Git on over here!
The Worm Holes#019.dst: 저 아래 내려갈 만큼 튼튼한 녀석이 필요한데... 응? 어이, 인간이잖아! 이리 와 봐!
The Worm Holes#019.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#020.src: I gotta ask, how much 'a that didja see, Wynn feller? Wasn't pretty, and I'm in charge a' them folks, so I gotta take responsibility fer that.
The Worm Holes#020.dst: 하나 묻자, 방금 거 얼마나 봤나, Wynn 친구? 보기 좋은 꼴은 아니었지. 내가 저 사람들 책임자니까 책임을 져야 해.
The Worm Holes#020.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#021.src: Th' mayor of {p} there saw these holes poppin' up, and hired us out to cover 'em up. Thing is, the ground's too unstable to build.
The Worm Holes#021.dst: 저기 {p} 시장이 이 구멍들이 생기는 걸 보고 메우라고 우릴 고용했지. 문제는 땅이 너무 불안정해서 뭘 지을 수가 없어.
The Worm Holes#021.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#022.src: It's gettin' real worrying round here. They only started openin' up recently, and there've been quakes too. Feels like the place is gonna collapse!
The Worm Holes#022.dst: 이 근처가 점점 걱정스러워. 구멍은 최근에야 생기기 시작했고, 지진도 있었어. 이러다 여기 통째로 무너질 것 같다고!
The Worm Holes#022.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#023.src: I think we oughta head down there and figure out what 'n heck's goin' on, and you're the best armed outta any of us, being human 'n all.
The Worm Holes#023.dst: 저 아래 내려가서 대체 무슨 일인지 알아봐야 할 것 같아. 인간이니 우리 중에 네가 제일 무장이 잘돼 있고.
The Worm Holes#023.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#024.src: Think y'all could head down 'n see if you can rustle up any leads? There's a path down just to the left of the hole.
The Worm Holes#024.dst: 내려가서 단서 좀 찾아봐 줄 수 있겠나? 구멍 바로 왼쪽에 내려가는 길이 있어.
The Worm Holes#024.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#025.src: Go down the hole and look for what's causing this and return to Malo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with proof.
The Worm Holes#025.dst: 구멍 아래로 내려가 원인을 찾고 증거를 가지고 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Malo에게 돌아가세요.

The Worm Holes#026.src: What in tarnation...? The heck did you find down there, soldier?
The Worm Holes#026.dst: 이게 대체 뭐야...? 저 아래서 뭘 찾은 거야, 병사?
The Worm Holes#026.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#027.src: Oh, it was just the skin, huh? Dang...was hopin' you'd've seen what it was, cause I got no clue 'bout this.
The Worm Holes#027.dst: 아, 그냥 허물이었어? 젠장... 정체를 봤길 바랐는데. 난 이게 뭔지 전혀 모르겠거든.
The Worm Holes#027.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#028.src: Urgh. Only gal I know who might have an idea 'bout this is that durn elf lady...
The Worm Holes#028.dst: 으. 이걸 알 만한 여자는 그 빌어먹을 엘프 아가씨밖에 없는데...
The Worm Holes#028.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#029.src: She's got purple hair and's been wanderin' round like she knows everything. Yeah, she's a bright penny but she ain't gotta be so uppity ta all of us 'bout it.
The Worm Holes#029.dst: 보라색 머리에, 다 아는 척하면서 여기저기 돌아다니지. 그래, 똑똑하긴 한데 우리한테 그렇게 잘난 척할 필요는 없잖아.
The Worm Holes#029.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#030.src: She put up a camp just east of here. She'll prob'ly react better to you than me, so I'll go to the authorities and see if they have any leads.
The Worm Holes#030.dst: 여기서 바로 동쪽에 야영지를 차렸어. 나보단 너한테 더 잘 대해 줄 거야. 난 당국에 가서 단서가 있나 알아보지.
The Worm Holes#030.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#031.src: Look for Lari and ask what is going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Worm Holes#032.src: ...Haven’t we met? I have witnessed your presence in Gavel more than once.
The Worm Holes#032.dst: ...우리 만난 적 있지 않아? Gavel에서 네 존재를 여러 번 목격했어.
The Worm Holes#032.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#033.src: I am Lari. I might have greeted you properly before if I were not so busy, which reminds me. You have a reason to be here, yes?
The Worm Holes#033.dst: 난 Lari야. 이렇게 바쁘지 않았다면 전에 제대로 인사했을 텐데, 그러고 보니. 여기 온 이유가 있지?
The Worm Holes#033.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#034.src: Hm...I believe I know what you have found, by your description. That dead skin too, is proof enough, I would say.
The Worm Holes#034.dst: 흠... 설명을 들어 보니 네가 뭘 찾았는지 알 것 같아. 그 허물도 충분한 증거고.
The Worm Holes#034.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#035.src: The creature which shed that skin is known as a Grootslang. Though large, they are rather peaceful. Gentle giants, I believe the saying is?
The Worm Holes#035.dst: 그 허물을 벗은 생물은 그루트슬랭이야. 덩치는 크지만 꽤 온순해. 온화한 거인이라고들 하지?
The Worm Holes#035.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#036.src: This horrid Decay...it affects their habitats underground. They are seeking shelter closer to the surface. I have been trying to scrub the Decay without success...
The Worm Holes#036.dst: 이 끔찍한 쇠락이... 땅속의 서식지에 영향을 주고 있어. 그래서 지표 가까이로 피난처를 찾는 거야. 쇠락을 씻어 내려 했지만 소용없었어...
The Worm Holes#036.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#037.src: Wait... More holes appeared just today? There...there were deaths?! W-where, when?!
The Worm Holes#037.dst: 잠깐... 오늘 구멍이 더 생겼다고? 그럼... 사람이 죽었어?! 어, 어디서, 언제?!
The Worm Holes#037.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#038.src: No, no...! I refuse to be responsible for any more deaths... Human, tell me your name, please.
The Worm Holes#038.dst: 안 돼, 안 돼...! 더는 누구의 죽음도 책임질 수 없어... 인간, 이름을 알려 줘.
The Worm Holes#038.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#039.src: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. {u}. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.
The Worm Holes#039.dst: {u}, 그렇구나... 현장으로 가자. {u}. 이걸 바로잡아야 해... 이 땅의 고통을 달랠 수 있게 문제의 근원을 찾도록 도와줘.
The Worm Holes#039.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#041.src: So this is the site... [Gavellian Spell]...
The Worm Holes#041.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#042.src: Here. Allow me to provide at least one person safe passage into the pit.
The Worm Holes#042.dst: 자. 적어도 한 사람은 안전하게 구덩이로 내려보내 줄게.
The Worm Holes#042.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#043.src: Have faith- Jump in. I will carry you down slowly.
The Worm Holes#043.dst: 날 믿어- 뛰어내려. 천천히 내려가게 해 줄게.
The Worm Holes#043.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#044.src: Take the lead. If we can find any further evidence of the Grootslangs around here, it will aid in my understanding.
The Worm Holes#044.dst: 앞장서. 이 근처에서 그루트슬랭의 흔적을 더 찾으면 이해하는 데 도움이 될 거야.
The Worm Holes#044.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#045.src: Hm? This wall looks like it's been disturbed recently...
The Worm Holes#045.dst: 응? 이 벽, 최근에 누가 건드린 것 같은데...
The Worm Holes#045.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#046.src: I can hear it...but where is it crawling...?
The Worm Holes#046.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#047.src: That's the mother Wyrm! She must be what is making the holes. We need to follow her!
The Worm Holes#047.dst: 어미 웜이야! 구멍을 만드는 게 저 녀석인가 봐. 따라가야 해!
The Worm Holes#047.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#048.src: Never mind the spiders, we need to keep following the Wyrm!
The Worm Holes#048.dst: 거미는 신경 쓰지 마, 계속 웜을 따라가야 해!
The Worm Holes#048.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#049.src: Ah...ehm, {u}? I've... Um, this is...a bit difficult to say, but...
The Worm Holes#049.dst: 아... 저기, {u}? 나... 음, 이건... 말하기 좀 어렵지만...
The Worm Holes#049.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#050.src: I...do not believe we need to fight, or to kill, here? The creatures are native to here, we are invading their space.
The Worm Holes#050.dst: 나는... 여기서 싸우거나 죽일 필요는 없다고 생각해. 이 생물들은 원래 여기 살아. 우리가 침입한 거야.
The Worm Holes#050.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#051.src: Why should they be attacked for merely existing in their territory? Even if they are animals, I believe that you can solve these problems without killing.
The Worm Holes#051.dst: 자기 영역에 존재한다는 이유만으로 공격받아야 해? 동물이라 해도, 넌 죽이지 않고도 해결할 수 있다고 믿어.
The Worm Holes#051.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#052.src: I...understand you may not have the same powers as myself... And I, ah...am not free of guilt, either. But I think you could stand to take a peaceful stance.
The Worm Holes#052.dst: 나는... 네게 나 같은 힘이 없다는 건 알아... 그리고 나도, 아... 죄가 없는 건 아니야. 그래도 평화로운 태도를 취해 볼 수 있을 것 같아.
The Worm Holes#052.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#054.src: Your methods are...disagreeable, but you still have a sense of right to you, I feel... Well, the tunnel diverges here. We'll need to split apart.
The Worm Holes#054.dst: 네 방식엔... 동의할 수 없지만, 그래도 옳고 그름을 아는 사람 같아... 자, 굴이 여기서 갈라져. 따로 가야겠어.
The Worm Holes#054.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#055.src: I'll go to the right, so you ought to continue to the left here. I will meet up with you again soon, hopefully.
The Worm Holes#055.dst: 난 오른쪽으로 갈게, 넌 여기서 왼쪽으로 계속 가. 곧 다시 만나길 바라.
The Worm Holes#055.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#058.src: Aah! {u}! Don't...don't make any sudden movements.
The Worm Holes#058.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#059.src: This Grootslang is uncharacteristically aggressive... She's scared, being so close to the surface. Stay behind me, please.
The Worm Holes#059.dst: 이 그루트슬랭, 평소답지 않게 사나워... 지표에 너무 가까워서 겁먹은 거야. 내 뒤에 있어 줘.
The Worm Holes#059.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#061.src: Do not approach it! The power of the Wyrm is far too much for you!
The Worm Holes#061.dst: 다가가지 마! 웜의 힘은 너한테 너무 벅차!
The Worm Holes#061.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#062.dst: 자, 잠깐, 또? [Gavellian Spell]- 아, 비켜!
The Worm Holes#062.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#063.src: {u}!! You're unharmed, yes? She's scared and in pain!
The Worm Holes#063.dst: {u}!! 다친 데 없지? 저 녀석, 겁먹고 아파하고 있어!
The Worm Holes#063.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#064.src: I have to get it right this time... I'm going to talk her down, stay there!
The Worm Holes#064.dst: 이번엔 제대로 해야 해... 내가 진정시킬게, 거기 있어!
The Worm Holes#064.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#065.src: You must be calm, I beg you. Retreat to the earth- You harm those above!
The Worm Holes#065.dst: 제발 진정해. 땅속으로 돌아가- 위에 있는 이들이 다치고 있어!
The Worm Holes#065.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#066.src: The earth rotting... I take full responsibility, but does the grass above not rot also?
The Worm Holes#066.dst: 땅이 썩어 가는 건... 전부 내 책임이야. 하지만 위의 풀도 썩어 가잖아?
The Worm Holes#066.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#067.src: I wish to soothe your pain, but you must allow me to aid you- You must listen!
The Worm Holes#067.dst: 네 고통을 달래 주고 싶어. 그러니 날 도와줄 수 있게 해 줘- 내 말 들어!
The Worm Holes#067.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#068.src: What does this violence solve? Be calm, please!
The Worm Holes#068.dst: 이런 폭력으로 뭐가 해결돼? 제발 진정해!
The Worm Holes#068.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#069.src: {u}, it won't budge... There's something in its mind rejecting me. Distract it- but don't approach! It will kill you if you get close. Just...be loud!
The Worm Holes#069.dst: {u}, 꿈쩍도 안 해... 뭔가가 머릿속에서 날 거부하고 있어. 주의를 끌어- 다가가진 마! 가까이 가면 죽어. 그냥... 시끄럽게 해!
The Worm Holes#069.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#072.src: Can you hear me?! I'll get her to...to...s-something! Spit you up, I don't know! Just...please, d-don't die!
The Worm Holes#072.dst: 내 말 들려?! 저 녀석이... 뭐, 뭐라도 하게 할게! 뱉어 내게 하든, 모르겠어! 그러니까... 제발, 주, 죽지 마!
The Worm Holes#072.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#073.src: W-We have... We have not laid a blow against you! It is not right for you to do the same!
The Worm Holes#073.dst: 우, 우린... 우린 너한테 한 대도 안 때렸어! 네가 그러는 건 옳지 않아!
The Worm Holes#073.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#074.src: You would wound and consume everything in your rage? Even knowing the consequences?
The Worm Holes#074.dst: 분노에 휩쓸려 모든 걸 다치게 하고 삼킬 거야? 결과를 알면서도?
The Worm Holes#074.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#075.src: Your hunger cannot be sated with this fruitless destruction! I beg of you, let them out!
The Worm Holes#075.dst: 이런 헛된 파괴로는 굶주림을 채울 수 없어! 제발, 그들을 내보내 줘!
The Worm Holes#075.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#076.src: You know th- W-wait...where did you... AAAH!
The Worm Holes#076.dst: 너도 알잖- 자, 잠깐... 어디서... 으아아!
The Worm Holes#076.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#078.src: I tried...w-why does no one listen to me? Why won't a-anything change for me?
The Worm Holes#078.dst: 노력했는데... 왜 아무도 내 말을 안 들어? 왜 나한텐 아, 아무것도 안 변해?
The Worm Holes#078.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#079.src: She...she's been eating dark parasites. They're wracking her insides and h-hurting her head...
The Worm Holes#079.dst: 저 녀석... 어둠의 기생충을 먹어 왔어. 그게 속을 갉아먹고 머리를 아, 아프게 해...
The Worm Holes#079.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#080.src: I...i-it's so d-dark... I c-can't breathe... This...th-this can't be the end...
The Worm Holes#080.dst: 나... 너, 너무 어, 어두워... 수, 숨을 못 쉬겠어... 이게... 이, 이게 끝일 리 없어...
The Worm Holes#080.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#081.src: I...n-no, I can't die in here... I-I'm needed still... You're n-needed still! I... I...
The Worm Holes#081.dst: 나... 아, 안 돼, 여기서 죽을 순 없어... 나, 난 아직 필요해... 너도 아, 아직 필요하고! 나... 나...
The Worm Holes#081.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#082.src: I n-need... Or... O-Or... C-Concentrate, Lari... You can do this...
The Worm Holes#082.dst: 피, 필요한 건... 아니면... 아, 아니면... 지, 집중해, Lari... 할 수 있어...
The Worm Holes#082.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#084.src: LET US OUT! LET US OUT OF HERE! DON'T LET US DIE LIKE THIS! I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE!!
The Worm Holes#084.dst: 내보내 줘! 여기서 내보내 줘! 이렇게 죽게 두지 마! 제발 부탁이야!!
The Worm Holes#084.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#085.src: ...I...oh no... It's...d-d... I... I j-just... I just w-wanted out... Ohhh...n-no...
The Worm Holes#085.dst: ...안 돼... 주, 죽었어... 난 그, 그냥 나가고 싶었을 뿐인데... 아, 안 돼...
The Worm Holes#085.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#086.src: ...w-we're...leaving. I...I c-can't look at this any more...
The Worm Holes#086.dst: ...이, 이제... 가자. 나... 더는 못 보, 보겠어...
The Worm Holes#086.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#088.src: I'm...I'm so sorry, {u}. If I'd...I don't... I don't even know what else I could have d-done...
The Worm Holes#088.dst: 정말... 정말 미안해, {u}. 내가 만약... 난... 내가 달리 뭘 할 수 있었을지도 모르겠어...
The Worm Holes#088.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#089.src: There...it didn’t feel like there was...anything left to it... But, if I’d just been quicker, then... Would it...would it even have made a difference?
The Worm Holes#089.dst: 거긴... 남은 게... 아무것도 없는 것 같았어... 그래도 내가 좀 더 빨랐다면... 그럼... 달라지긴 했을까?
The Worm Holes#089.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#090.src: ...some savior I am... I need to be better, but what else even is there that...ugh, I'm going in circles...
The Worm Holes#090.dst: ...구원자는 무슨... 더 잘해야 하는데, 달리 뭐가... 으, 같은 생각만 맴돌아...
The Worm Holes#090.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#092.src: ...I...I can't believe this. This is...does destiny just hate me? What have I done to deserve this?!
The Worm Holes#092.dst: ...나... 믿을 수가 없어. 이건... 운명이 날 미워하는 걸까? 내가 뭘 잘못했길래?!
The Worm Holes#092.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#093.src: The Mother Wyrm laid eggs... Eggs infested with parasites! Every single one is going to be born berserk!!
The Worm Holes#093.dst: 어미 웜이 알을 낳았어... 기생충에 감염된 알을! 하나하나가 전부 미쳐 날뛰는 채로 태어날 거야!!
The Worm Holes#093.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#094.src: You saw how strong the mother was...an infestation like this could cause the entire region of Gavel to collapse in a quake...
The Worm Holes#094.dst: 어미가 얼마나 강했는지 봤잖아... 이렇게 감염이 퍼지면 Gavel 지역 전체가 지진으로 무너질지도 몰라...
The Worm Holes#094.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#095.src: They...they need to be stopped, but...I can't do it. I c-can't kill... I'm sorry, I just can't!
The Worm Holes#095.dst: 저것들... 막아야 하는데... 난 못 해. 난 주, 죽일 수 없어... 미안, 도저히 못 하겠어!
The Worm Holes#095.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#096.src: Bring a group... Even Whelps can be a terror if they're enraged. Just...p-please, take care of this quickly.
The Worm Holes#096.dst: 사람들을 데려와... 새끼라도 분노하면 무시무시할 수 있어. 그러니... 제, 제발 빨리 처리해 줘.
The Worm Holes#096.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#097.src: You deserve the best... But that's more than I can give...so here. Take these. I'll move along.
The Worm Holes#097.dst: 넌 최고의 보상을 받을 자격이 있지만... 내가 줄 수 있는 건 이게 다야... 자, 이거 받아. 난 이만 갈게.
The Worm Holes#097.speaker: Lari
